info.title: Corporate Fleet Management - Maintenance Planning & History API
info.description: Deterministic RESTful API for maintenance planning, status transitions, cancellation tracking, and immutable audit history.

get.description: The system shall expose GET /health publicly with no input or authorization requirement.
The system shall expose GET /vehicles as an admin-only endpoint with stable pagination.
The system shall expose GET /maintenances restricting standard users to requester-owned records.

post.description: The system shall expose POST /maintenances creating SCHEDULED record and initial history event.

get.description: The system shall expose GET /maintenances/{maintenance_id} returning record to requester or admin.

patch.description: The system shall expose PATCH /maintenances/{maintenance_id} updating only SCHEDULED records.

409.description: Maintenance not SCHEDULED or interval overlap

post.description: The system shall expose POST /maintenances/{maintenance_id}/start moving record to IN_PROGRESS.

409.description: Record not SCHEDULED or vehicle state != MAINTENANCE

post.description: The system shall expose POST /maintenances/{maintenance_id}/complete moving record to COMPLETED.

409.description: Record not IN_PROGRESS or invalid actual_end

post.description: The system shall expose POST /maintenances/{maintenance_id}/cancel retaining immutable history.

409.description: Record already terminal or invalid cancelled_at

get.description: The system shall expose GET /maintenances/{maintenance_id}/history returning immutable status events.
The system shall expose GET /vehicles/{vehicle_id}/maintenance-history as an admin-only endpoint.
The system shall expose GET /vehicles/{vehicle_id}/maintenance-availability returning active overlapping records.
